steps: Get an online quote for your electronics on Target's trade-in page
Accept the quote (valid 30 days) and request the free mail-in kit
Ship the device with the prepaid label
Target receives, inspects, and processes it; eGiftCard arrives within seven business days after receipt/processing
timing: Target eGiftCard within seven business days after receipt and processing; quote honored for 30 days.
who_pays: Target - the payout comes from Target as a Target eGiftCard, not cash.
who_qualifies: You must be 18+, in the US, and own the device. Only eligible electronics are accepted.
work_available: Yes - the program was live on Target's help pages as of 2026-09-23. It covers eligible electronics; value varies by device, condition, and demand.
what_gets_accepted: Your online quote is locked for 30 days, but the inspected value can come in lower if the device's condition does not match your answers. Items that fail inspection are worth $0.
costs_and_unpaid_time: No fees; the mail-in kit ships free. Your unpaid time is getting the quote (about 15-30 minutes), packaging, and waiting through transit plus up to seven business days after receipt for processing.
when_cash_arrives: NOT cash - a Target eGiftCard arrives within seven business days after your device is received and processed. It only spends at Target and cannot be converted to cash.
